title: Non abelian Reidemeister torsion and volume form on the SU(2)-representation space of knot groups
note: Ann. Inst. Fourier (Grenoble) 55(5) (2005), 1685-1734; arXiv:math/0403470v4. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.5802/aif.2136) and arXiv API (2026-11-28). Defines sign-determined non-abelian adjoint Reidemeister torsion for knot exteriors at mu-regular representations and proves equality with the Casson-Lin-Heusener symplectic volume form on the SU(2)-character variety (Theorem 7.1, label T:Volume=Torsion).
